calibration.independence: Separate C executable compiled from native-observer.c, no ARC library, IPC or sampler; foreign-PID process observations
calibration.accuracyVerdict: Actual discrepancies recorded; no unstated accuracy pass threshold
calibration.derivedPressure: Filesystem pressure is a separately labeled derivation; native memory pressure is observed independently

idle.warmupRule: >=30000 monotonic ms quiet after calibration and actual native desktop hide; no admitted build/coverage/load generation

cpu.formula: 100 * (end foreign-PID user+system core-seconds - start) / monotonic elapsed seconds; no logical-core divisor
cpu.resolution: Mach tick = 125/3 ns on this host; native accounting updates and printed floating-point seconds limit effective precision

rss.semantics: Maximum of discrete current-RSS readings during this interval; not continuous or process-lifetime high-water proof

supplementalShutdownLifetimeRusage.source: parent wait4; macOS ru_maxrss bytes; entire process lifetime, not measured-interval RSS

observer.identity: Standalone native C foreign-PID reader; CPU/RSS and CoreGraphics metadata; no ARC library or instrumentation

activity.requestsDuringObserverWindow: No task CLI, job submission, build, coverage or load-generator command; native process/window observer only

contention.limits: Snapshot metadata cannot exclude a process that starts and exits between observations, arbitrary renamed workloads or unrelated ambient activity.

idle.ambientActivity: Existing OS and user activity continued; record load averages and native calibration CPU. No unrelated processes were stopped or adjusted.

provenance.currentInputNativeTests: Required CLI/bridge native tests re-executed in exact current workspace/coverage gates, distinct from replaying task-8 to repair its earlier review.

observerRepair.reason: Task-9 native calibration exposed unscaled Mach ticks in task-8 reference tool
observerRepair.supersedes: Only failed/unperformed task-9 measurement acceptance; original task-8 integration evidence remains its original identity

refreshReason: Full-input native evidence refreshed after test-only synchronization repair and actual desktop compatibility rebuild. The fresh desktop digest differs; this run observes its immutable byte copy. No prior receipt identity rewritten.
limits: This bounded run establishes neither long-term performance nor customer savings.
Read-only process snapshots cannot prove absence of short-lived, renamed or inaccessible ambient workloads.
Native desktop metadata is actual visibility evidence, not screenshot, browser, assistive-technology or WebKit persistence verification.
Final six gates, desktop compatibility and independent read-only QA remain subsequent assigned tasks.
